_what: Limits for the fragility-driven grip (fragility_grasp.py). Nothing here is a per-object value.
_squeeze_min_rad_source: 17 Sep: squeeze 0.08 picked apple_02 (0.40 kg) 2/2 and apple_10 (0.70 kg, heaviest) 6/6
_squeeze_max_rad_source: the tested default that picked all ten apples; 0.16 dropped apple_10 0/2, so no estimate may go above 0.12
_effort_saturation_nm_source: finger joint effort caps at 1.50 Nm; a finger already there cannot report further stiffness
_observe_rad_source: touch is read over the first 0.03 rad of the normal squeeze (5 steps), then the rest of the squeeze is chosen; must stay below squeeze_min_rad. Replaces the 0.02 rad probe, which dropped 3 of 10 apples
